text.p: Microelectronic Packaging Inc said that, effective immediately, it is liquidating its MPS Singapore Pte Ltd unit and selling most of its assets to Micropac Technology Pte Ltd.
Micropac is a newly-formed business unit of Innoventure Pte Ltd, an Indonesian company, which has partially manufactured the ceramic packages sold by MPS.
Among reasons for the move, a news release from Microelectronic cited a sharp decline in market demand for EPROM, CERDIP and other packaging manufactured by MPS and losses at the firm.
Restructured MPS operations will continue under Micropac with minimal anticipated disruption to MPS's customers, operations or employees, the release said.
The liquidation is expected to result in a reduction in the company's indebtedness of about $9 million.
